verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a broad REST API v2. It can book meetings, read and write Scheduling, Contacts and Notetaker data, create event types (POST /event_types), manage users, read availability and manage webhook subscriptions, and an MCP server maps tools to REST endpoints. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: any stated UI–API parity commitment, API evidence for configuring Workflows, routing forms, payments, polls, booking-page customization and availability rules (buffers, daily limits), and independent hands-on corroboration of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
